sam: Heads-up — new compact keys list v2 ready for review. Focus areas: soft-delete + undo, revoke vs disable language, keyboard flow. mock: https://files.redwood.ai/preview/compact-keys-v2.png kevin: Quick skim — looks promising. Question: are we treating soft-delete as 'revoked' or 'disabled'? UX should make recovery friction explicit. mia: Accessibility note: toasts for undo should use aria-live. Prefer 'polite' to avoid interrupting screen reader users, but we need a clear focus path for keyboard users. alex: Frontend constraints: toast + undo button needs to be reachable via keyboard without moving focus off the page. We'll avoid autofocus; instead expose a live region and a visible undo action in the details panel. jen: Copy nit: 'Revoke key' reads super destructive. Users expect 'Disable' for temporary block. Suggest separating 'Disable (soft)' vs 'Revoke permanently'. sam: Proposal: three states — Active, Disabled (temporary block), Revoked (soft-delete recoverable for 7 days). UI: yellow 'Revoked (recoverable)' chip + 10s undo toast + persistent 'Recover' in details drawer. kevin: I like that. For permanent delete, show a separate destructive flow with confirmation and a checkbox: 'I understand this permanently deletes the key'. Color hierarchy: gentle amber for recoverable, deeper red for permanent. mia: Keyboard/AX specifics: ensure each key row has a single tabbable overflow menu. In the menu, actions need accessible names like 'Disable key for project-alpha' and 'Revoke key permanently for project-alpha'. Also announce state changes: role="status" aria-live="polite" text = 'Key disabled. Undo available.' alex: Implementation note: we can wire analytics events: key.action.disabled, key.action.revoked, key.action.recovered with reason tags. Also hide revoke option for SSO-managed keys (show 'Managed externally'). sam: Edge-case: integrations that pull the key (e.g., webhook consumers) — should tenant admins get a warning about active sessions? Need copy that mentions "may break running integrations". jen: Suggested modal copy: title: 'Revoke key permanently?'. Body: 'This will stop all current integrations using this key. To proceed, type the key name and check "I understand".' Primary CTA: 'Revoke permanently' (destructive). Secondary CTA: 'Disable instead' (non-destructive). kevin: Empty state idea: headline 'No API keys yet' with two CTAs: 'Create key' and 'View example integrations'. Add small hint: 'Create with least privilege: choose scopes for each key.' mia: Empty state AX: make primary CTA a big focusable button with aria-label 'Create new API key'. Provide a skip link to 'example integrations' for SR users. alex: Small PR-friendly code snippet for the live region we can use:
Key revoked —
alex: For the toast itself we'll include a data-action=\"undo\" and ensure Esc closes it. sam: Also want to surface key scopes inline in compact rows as micro-badges. Hover to expand the full scope list. Concern: visual noise in dense lists — maybe show only first two scopes + '+n' indicator. kevin: Good call. Visual treatment: small pill badges, muted border, tooltip on hover. For keyboard, expose 'Show scopes' in overflow menu. mia: SR phrasing for undo: 'Key "project-alpha" revoked. Press Undo to restore access.' I'll draft exact strings and send. aria-bot: deploybot: mock image uploaded to /design-storage/compact-keys-v2.png (sha256:abc123) jen: :thumbsup: Great discussion. Plan: Kevin updates mocks with amber recoverable chip + softer red for permanent revoke. Alex prototypes keyboard flow + live region. Mia drafts screen reader strings. Sam to confirm retention window (7 days?) with compliance. Aim to ship to beta next sprint. sam: Thanks — I'll add tickets and assign next steps.
